findings.evidence: `rg -n "realOperator_continuousWithinAt|continuous.*realOperator_orbit" code/TauCeti/Analysis/Semigroups/Basic.lean` shows existing `realOperator_continuousWithinAt` at lines 137 and 408, followed by the four new `continuous*_realOperator_orbit` names at lines 428, 447, 454, and 460.
findings.fix: Rename these to the local object-first pattern, e.g. `realOperator_continuous`, `realOperator_continuousOn_Ici`, `realOperator_continuousAt`, and `realOperator_continuousOn_uIcc`.
findings.issue: The new lemmas are named `continuous*_realOperator_orbit...`, but adjacent public API for the same applied map is `realOperator_continuousWithinAt`; Mathlib naming guidance says adjacent consistency beats a theoretically better name, and `orbit` is not a declared object here.

findings.evidence: Line 449 states `ContinuousOn ... (Set.Ici 0)`, while line 460 names the analogous interval result `..._uIcc`; the naming reference says theorem names describe conclusions outward and the set dictionary names `Ici`/`uIcc` explicitly.
findings.fix: Include the domain suffix, preferably as part of the object-first rename: `realOperator_continuousOn_Ici`.
findings.issue: `continuousOn_realOperator_orbit` proves continuity only on `Set.Ici 0` but the name omits the set, while the companion interval lemma includes `_uIcc`; set-specific `ContinuousOn` lemmas should name the set when the domain is part of the conclusion.

summary: The new continuity wrappers use a naming pattern inconsistent with the existing public `realOperator` API in the same namespace, and one set-specific name omits its domain while another includes it.
